# Docker

Starter template containerized with Docker for consistent deployments.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://www.docker.com/" title="Docker" description="Container platform." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/docker-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run with Docker:

```bash
docker-compose up
```

Or run locally:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Dockerfile included
- Multi-stage builds for smaller images
- Production-ready setup

## Docker Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-robo-bot .

# Run the container
docker run -d my-robo-bot

# Use docker-compose
docker-compose up -d
```

## Hosting

Deploy to any Docker-compatible platform or use RoboPlay:

```bash
npm run deploy
```
